name: Choose the next intervention
decision: what can I change to improve my solution?
description: Choose the next change or diagnostic experiment according to the current evidence and bottleneck.

children.name: Repair incorrect predictions
children.decision: Which failure mechanism should be repaired first?
children.description: Choose the repair indicated by concrete discrepancies in the prediction pipeline.

children.name: Repair row and feature alignment
children.description: Join predictions and features by stable identifiers and restore the exact training column order.

children.name: Restore checkpoint compatibility
children.description: Load weights with the matching architecture, configuration, tokenizer, and training artifacts and verify loaded keys.

children.name: Correct aggregation arithmetic
children.description: Fix accumulation, denominators, array types, and model dispatch so every intended prediction contributes exactly once.

children.name: Repair output semantics and submission wiring
children.description: Correct output direction, activation, selected prediction variable, and submission schema before scoring again.

children.name: Correct API and dependency failures
children.description: Choose the concrete intervention indicated by the observed failure or bottleneck.

children.name: Repair imports and artifact paths
children.description: Make required modules and saved artifacts available under the paths used by the active environment.

children.name: Align model and tensor devices
children.description: Place the model and every input on a supported common device and confirm library hardware support.

children.name: Match the library API
children.description: Correct function arguments, return types, dataframe operations, or prediction methods to match the invoked API.

children.decision: Which execution contract is violated?

children.name: Trace the active inference path
children.description: Run a small end-to-end example and repair stale variables, inactive code paths, or placeholder fallback outputs.

children.name: Improve the experiment evidence
children.decision: What evidence-producing change should guide the next modeling decision?
children.description: Choose an experiment design that resolves the current uncertainty before further optimization.

children.name: Choose a diagnostic comparison
children.decision: Which comparison resolves the current uncertainty?
children.description: Choose among isolating a change, reproducing noise, rolling back, or ending an exhausted search.

children.name: Run a controlled ablation
children.description: Change one factor against a frozen baseline or use a small factorial comparison when factors interact.

children.name: Estimate repeatability
children.description: Repeat a fixed configuration with pinned artifacts and compare score distributions before trusting small gains.

children.name: Restore the last verified configuration
children.description: Restore the complete known-good configuration before reintroducing candidate improvements individually.

children.name: Stop a saturated local search
children.description: Freeze the best verified settings and redirect experiments to a different source of signal.

children.name: Establish a complete baseline
children.description: Run a minimal end-to-end model and score its actual submission before extending the pipeline.

children.name: Bracket a scalar search
children.description: Use a coarse sweep followed by smaller steps around the best validated region while holding other settings fixed.

children.name: Check validation ranking credibility
children.description: Compare local and external model rankings and investigate preprocessing or population mismatch before selecting more checkpoints.

children.name: Replace a weak baseline with a coherent pipeline
children.description: Evaluate an integrated domain-appropriate pipeline as a new baseline when the current approach is substantially underpowered.

children.name: Choose the validation design
children.decision: Which validation split best approximates the prediction setting?
children.description: Choose a split using the sampling units, target distribution, and expected test population.

children.name: Keep related samples together
children.description: Use group-aware folds, with label stratification when feasible, to prevent related samples crossing boundaries.

children.name: Balance targets across folds
children.description: Use stratified folds or bins of a continuous target to stabilize fold label distributions.

children.name: Validate on the target population
children.description: Construct validation membership around the population expected at test time while explicitly handling other training subgroups.

children.name: Adjust validation coverage
children.description: Compare holdout size, fold count, or nested versus flat validation while preserving the chosen sampling boundaries.

children.name: Align local evaluation with the task
children.description: Verify the exact task metric and direction locally and compare task-aligned versus surrogate early-stopping criteria when curves are unstable.

children.name: Inspect the prediction units
children.description: Profile entity sizes, feature groups, data types, missingness, and target support before selecting a representation.

children.name: Change the information supplied
children.decision: Which input-side change addresses the missing or misleading signal?
children.description: Choose between changing examples, feature content, feature selection, and the representation seen by the model.

children.name: Choose the training examples
children.decision: How should the training sample distribution change?
children.description: Choose filtering, weighting, augmentation, or additional data according to coverage and label quality.

children.name: Filter or curate examples
children.description: Remove or down-weight demonstrably noisy, duplicate, or mismatched training examples and validate the retained coverage.

children.name: Reweight observed examples
children.description: Tune class or subgroup weights while keeping the original observations.

children.name: Augment labeled examples
children.description: Test label-preserving transforms or feature-space interpolation with controlled strength.

children.name: Add auxiliary labeled data
children.description: Add compatible labeled examples from another source with explicit filtering and source-aware evaluation.

children.name: Use pseudo-labeled examples
children.description: Train or select checkpoints that incorporate reliable pseudo-labels from unlabeled data.

children.name: Choose a new feature representation
children.decision: Which feature representation should be tested next?
children.description: Choose the representation whose information is absent from the current model inputs.

children.name: Summarize entity histories
children.description: Add per-entity summary statistics and recent-window aggregates using only information available for prediction.

children.name: Encode change and interactions
children.description: Add lag differences, ratios, time features, or domain-motivated interactions beyond marginal summaries.

children.name: Add structural and linguistic features
children.description: Test structural, linguistic, or metadata statistics as an additional feature block and retain them only if they improve validation.

children.name: Tune sparse or latent text features
children.description: Tune n-gram vocabulary, frequency filters, or low-dimensional decompositions of sparse text features.

children.name: Add pretrained representations
children.description: Evaluate an aligned pretrained representation or auxiliary out-of-fold prediction block as features for a downstream learner.

children.name: Add a complementary signal representation
children.description: Construct one complementary raw-signal, spectral, derived-channel, or reshaped representation and evaluate it with a compatible trained branch.

children.name: Select input branches by ablation
children.description: Disable or restore one input modality at a time with compatible weights and compare against the full-input model.

children.name: Choose a feature retention policy
children.decision: How should the candidate feature set be reduced or retained?
children.description: Choose a retention policy based on reliable feature evidence and downstream compatibility.

children.name: Tune ranked retention
children.description: Sweep the number of retained features using fold-based importance and validation on the current feature set.

children.name: Remove or restore feature groups
children.description: Ablate coherent feature groups and retain only groups with supported incremental benefit.

children.name: Regenerate compatible feature selection
children.description: Recompute or reload a selection artifact that matches the current feature names and training folds.

children.name: Choose the input transformation
children.decision: Which transformation should change while the model configuration is held fixed?
children.description: Choose a concrete preprocessing intervention based on modality and training-time expectations.

children.name: Restore training preprocessing
children.description: Reproduce the checkpoint training transforms, input layout, normalization, and operation order.

children.name: Sweep image resolution
children.description: Compare nearby image sizes with fixed compatible weights and head architecture.

children.name: Adjust text cleaning and formatting
children.description: Ablate text normalization, cropping, prompts, paired inputs, or metadata formatting with a matched tokenizer.

children.name: Change imputation or numeric scaling
children.description: Choose the concrete intervention indicated by the observed failure or bottleneck.

children.name: Use model-appropriate missing values
children.description: Retain native missing values for supporting learners or fit the required imputation on training data.

children.name: Adjust numeric representation
children.description: Compare scaling, rounding, outlier handling, or storage precision while keeping features and folds fixed.

children.decision: How should numeric input problems be handled?

children.name: Tune spectral extraction
children.description: Compare time-frequency resolution, log scaling, clipping, and normalization using compatible signal models.

children.name: Tune temporal or spatial coverage
children.description: Sweep crop locations or context-window lengths while preserving alignment to the prediction target.

children.name: Adjust signal filtering
children.description: Test a matched bandpass or notch filter implementation and validate signal preservation.

children.name: Change the predictor
children.decision: Which predictor change is the most promising replacement experiment?
children.description: Choose between new saved weights, a different model family, and a changed prediction architecture.

children.name: Select a different checkpoint
children.description: Compare saved folds, epochs, or training-stage checkpoints with preprocessing and aggregation fixed.

children.name: Replace the model family or capacity
children.description: Compare a different algorithm, backbone, or capacity under a controlled evaluation.

children.name: Use domain-adapted weights
children.description: Compare domain-pretrained or continued-pretraining weights with a matched inference configuration.

children.name: Choose the prediction architecture
children.decision: How should the representation be converted into predictions?
children.description: Choose a head or fusion mechanism that addresses the limitation of the current architecture.

children.name: Enrich pooling or attention
children.description: Test attention, alternate pooling, normalization, or a hidden layer in the prediction head with correspondingly trained weights.

children.name: Simplify the prediction head
children.description: Replace an unnecessarily complex or separate-head design with a simpler shared head and compatible weights.

children.name: Add auxiliary or ordinal outputs
children.description: Train a classification, ordinal, or auxiliary head aligned with the structure of the target.

children.name: Fuse complementary branch embeddings
children.description: Compare concatenation and elementwise fusion of branch embeddings with a correspondingly trained head.

children.name: Change how the predictor is fitted
children.decision: Which training control should be changed next?
children.description: Choose the training control indicated by convergence, generalization, and target structure.

children.name: Tune tree capacity
children.description: Sweep tree depth or leaf count while holding features and other training controls fixed.

children.name: Tune regularization
children.description: Sweep penalties, row or column subsampling, or training dropout against a fixed baseline.

children.name: Tune optimizer and learning schedule
children.description: Compare learning rates, optimizers, or decay schedules while allowing sufficient optimization steps.

children.name: Tune training duration
children.description: Adjust epochs, boosting rounds, and early-stopping patience using the intended validation signal.

children.name: Change the training objective
children.description: Use or tune a loss formulation that better reflects the evaluation metric and target constraints.

children.name: Change target construction
children.description: Compare target centering, censoring transforms, or group-aware target encodings without leaking validation labels.

children.name: Change the boosting procedure
children.description: Compare boosting variants or training interfaces with equivalent prediction and validation semantics.

children.name: Standardize per-fold fitting
children.description: Use an explicit fold training loop with validation, batch loading, and separately persisted checkpoints and predictions.

children.name: Change prediction combination
children.decision: Which ensemble intervention should be tested next?
children.description: Choose member selection, fold or seed replication, or a different combination rule.

children.name: Choose the member set
children.decision: How should the ensemble member set change?
children.description: Choose expansion, replacement, pruning, or restoration based on marginal contributions.

children.name: Add a complementary member
children.description: Test one candidate from a different architecture, representation, training recipe, or prediction source at a modest weight.

children.name: Replace a weak member
children.description: Swap one stagnant ensemble component for a stronger compatible variant while holding other members fixed.

children.name: Prune or retain through ablation
children.description: Remove one suspected weak member or compare the best single model with the full ensemble before simplifying.

children.name: Restore lost diversity
children.description: Reintroduce previously beneficial members after a simplification or replacement reduced ensemble quality.

children.name: Choose repeated predictors
children.decision: Which kind of replication should reduce prediction variance?
children.description: Choose fold, seed, augmented-view, or stochastic-forward averaging according to the available variation.

children.name: Select and average fold checkpoints
children.description: Compare subsets of valid fold checkpoints and retain the fold coverage that improves validation.

children.name: Average independent training runs
children.description: Average distinct seed or training-run predictions and stop when repeat-count gains plateau.

children.name: Average valid transformed views
children.description: Compare geometric, temporal-crop, or domain-symmetry test-time averaging against unaugmented inference.

children.name: Control inference stochasticity
children.description: Compare deterministic evaluation with intentional multi-pass dropout and average only genuinely stochastic predictions.

children.name: Choose the aggregation rule
children.decision: How should aligned predictions be combined?
children.description: Choose the combination rule according to metric sensitivity, calibration, and available out-of-fold data.

children.name: Use uniform averaging
children.description: Use an equal-weight mean as a baseline or revert to it when tuned weights do not generalize.

children.name: Tune fixed blend weights
children.description: Compare fixed blend weights using aligned predictions, prefer held-out evaluation, and revalidate the weights after component changes.

children.name: Probe signed weights
children.description: Test a constrained negative auxiliary coefficient only when held-out residual evidence supports subtraction.

children.name: Compare rank and raw aggregation
children.description: Run a controlled rank-normalized versus raw prediction averaging comparison with fixed members and retain the validated rule.

children.name: Compare logit and probability pooling
children.description: Compare normalized logit pooling with probability averaging while preserving valid class distributions.

children.name: Test nonlinear pooling
children.description: Compare a power, geometric, or other explicit nonlinear pooling rule against the same arithmetic blend.

children.name: Fit a regularized meta-learner
children.description: Train and validate a simple meta-model on leak-free out-of-fold predictions and compare it with fixed averaging.

children.name: Change the output mapping
children.decision: Which output mapping fits the target and metric?
children.description: Choose calibration or discretization based on target support and verified prediction semantics.

children.name: Tune ordinal cutpoints
children.description: Fit and validate cutpoints that convert continuous predictions to ordered labels, including simple rounding as a baseline.

children.name: Match discrete target support
children.description: Compare assigning ordered labels by target-frequency quantiles with ordinary per-sample threshold rounding.

children.name: Calibrate prediction scale
children.description: Validate a bias, scale, probability transform, or inverse-link correction without changing member identity.

children.name: Apply a supported conditional correction
children.description: Compare subgroup-specific thresholds or auxiliary-signal corrections with a global mapping.

children.name: Remove ineffective postprocessing
children.description: Ablate a calibration or discretization rule and retain raw outputs or a simpler mapping when it generalizes better.

children.name: Change execution to enable useful experiments
children.decision: Which execution change removes the observed bottleneck?
children.description: Choose a concrete execution intervention that preserves the intended model outputs.

children.name: Use a representative smoke run
children.description: Add a small-data or reduced-fold mode and verify the full production mode before submission.

children.name: Cache reusable computations
children.description: Persist versioned features, per-model predictions, or trained artifacts so unchanged expensive stages can be reused.

children.name: Bound memory with chunks and sequential loads
children.description: Choose the concrete intervention indicated by the observed failure or bottleneck.

children.name: Stream complete sample groups
children.description: Run feature generation and prediction in chunks that preserve complete prediction entities.

children.name: Release completed stages
children.description: Load models sequentially and delete unused tensors, dataframes, and framework caches after their last consumer.

children.decision: Which memory allocation should be reduced?

children.name: Tune inference batching and precision
children.description: Adjust batch size, sequence bucketing, worker count, or numeric precision while checking prediction equivalence.

children.name: Centralize reproducible configuration
children.description: Replace scattered hardcoded variants with explicit configuration, model registries, and stage interfaces.

children.name: Refactor with output equivalence
children.description: Simplify or separate training and inference code while comparing intermediate and final outputs against a saved baseline.

children.name: Accelerate repeated metric evaluation
children.description: Replace a slow scoring implementation with an equivalent optimized implementation verified on fixed predictions.

children.name: Use a compatible signal backend
children.description: Use a working CPU or GPU signal-processing implementation and verify numerical equivalence before changing backends.

children.name: Eliminate repeated conversions
children.description: Move invariant dataframe conversions and group calculations outside inner loops and reuse the results.
